SQLi.description: SQL Injection (SQLi) is the manipulation of a database through malicious SQL code injected into user input fields.

submodules.title: SQL Injection - Authentication Bypass
submodules.description: This laboratory examines the authentication bypass vulnerability caused by adding user inputs directly into SQL queries.

IDOR.description: Insecure Direct Object References (IDOR) occur when an application provides direct access to objects based on user-supplied input without proper access control checks.

submodules.title: IDOR - Access Control & Unauthorized Profile Inspection
submodules.description: This laboratory demonstrates how weak object-level authorization allows low-privileged users to inspect sensitive records of other accounts.

CommandInjection.description: OS Command Injection allows an attacker to execute arbitrary operating system commands on the server running an application.

submodules.title: Command Injection - Arbitrary OS Execution via Network Diagnostics
submodules.description: This laboratory explores OS command injection risks in network utilities and demonstrates input sanitization and strict parameter isolation fixes.
